params.prompt:
Repaint this blockout video as a finished hand-painted gouache animation. VERTICAL 9:16 portrait frame, frame for frame: keep the exact camera, framing, timing and every pose from the source video, and paint only what each source frame shows, adding no other characters or objects.

Character: the flame-shaped figure is Sol, exactly the mascot in the reference images (the turnaround sheet shows his shape from every side; the expression sheet shows every eye shape he makes). Round, plump gumdrop body with a red outer layer, an orange middle layer and a broad cream inner flame for the face. At rest his face is plain smooth cream with exactly two small tall navy #1C2447 oval eyes set low and close together, solid dark with no whites or highlights, and nothing else on it. His eyes change ONLY as the beats below say; copy his eyes from each source frame exactly, the same shape, size and place. Short stubby rounded red-orange arm nubs and two tiny blunt stubby red feet. Sol wears nothing. Sol gives off no sparks, particles or smoke. His layers and face move together as one body with a small soft wobble that settles.

Scene: a bedroom desk on a school morning. A honey-coloured wooden desk top fills the lower part of the frame; on it lie three crumpled balls of white paper and marker pens, exactly where the source video shows them. Behind the desk is a dusty-teal wall with one round wall clock (teal rim, white face with plain tick marks and no numerals, two dark hands that never move), one wooden shelf holding a small potted plant and three books, and at the right edge a white-framed window glowing with sunlight. At the back left of the desk stands a teal desk lamp with a yellow shade. Warm morning sunlight with soft cool shadows, so the room has depth and glow. In the middle of the desk stands one white trifold poster board: a flat middle panel, two side wings angled toward the camera, and a white header board across its top. The whole poster is clean, empty white. It never moves. LETTERING RULE: every board, sheet of paper, card, tag and page in this shot is BLANK. Paint no letters, no numbers, no words, no symbols and no handwriting anywhere in the frame. Where the source video shows Sol's flame tip tinted deep indigo-violet, fading down into his normal orange, paint exactly that tint and exactly as much of it as each source frame shows. The few thin short navy vertical lines high on the left side of his face belong to that look: copy them only in the frames where the source shows them. 

Beats: 1. Sol stands on the desk at the front left, turned a little toward the poster, his two navy oval eyes looking sideways at it. 2. At 1.8 seconds he tilts back and looks up at the wall clock. 3. At 2.5 seconds he jolts with one small hop and both arm nubs up: his eyes become two round navy rings with white centres, his flame tip turns deep indigo-violet, and thin short lines appear high on the left side of his face. 4. He lands and settles, still facing the camera. At 4.7 seconds his eyes are two navy ovals again; the indigo tip and the thin lines stay. 5. At 5.5 seconds he nods once. In the final half second his two navy oval eyes are open.

Style: use the painted reference image ONLY for its gouache paint treatment and brushwork; do not copy its room, its objects or its layout. Take every colour from the source video. Soft matte gouache painting with visible brushwork, broad simplified shapes, layered colour, softened painted edges and subtle paper texture on Sol, the props and the room alike. Forms defined by light and colour. No ink outlines, no black linework, not glossy 3D, not vector art. Smooth natural motion, no motion blur, stable background paint texture. No text, no captions, no speech, no music.
